column1: # OpenSSL's module surface, derived by tools/surface.py from the headers compat.openssl installs
# (do not edit by hand). build.mcpp writes the module sources from it, as the package is built.
#   [<module> <kind>]       name [, the condition it is declared under]: exported by `using`
#   [adapted]               module, name, result, then parameter name and type, each: an inline
#                           function of the headers, declared again in mcpplibs::mwrap::openssl
#   [constants]             name [, condition]: in mcpplibs::mwrap::openssl::macros, its value
#   [calls]                 name, the function it calls, result, then parameter name and type, each
#   [textual]               name, why it stays a macro (<mwrap/openssl/macros.hpp>)
